meaning: the entity is one Map Creator obstacle-detection exclusion: a cell and a heading at which a robot's obstacle sensor is suppressed, because a fixture there would otherwise read as an obstacle

schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

schema.description: the entity is one Map Creator obstacle-detection exclusion: a cell and a heading at which a robot's obstacle sensor is suppressed, because a fixture there would otherwise read as an obstacle

cell.description: The cell the exclusion's tuple names, by entity identity. The tuple itself is `external_ids.mapcreator_ods_tuple`, and the export rebuilds it from this cell's barcode and the heading.

cell_barcode_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `ods_tuple` verbatim, present only when the barcode half names no cell of this dump — 24 of one site's 180 do not. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

excluded.description: Map Creator's `excluded`, carried as the export states it.

heading.description: The heading half of Map Creator's `ods_tuple`, as the export spells it.

tuple_unparsed.description: Map Creator's `ods_tuple` verbatim, present only when it does not split into a barcode and a heading at all. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

schema.title: ods_exclusion
